"We're thinking about that," Trump said when asked if the federal gas tax should be suspended, without providing more details.
Trump has also previously expressed support for suspending the US gas tax in recent months.
Trump's comments came a day after he signed an executive order to expand access to tax-exempt diesel that he unveiled from a rally stage in Nebraska.
High gas and diesel prices are a risk to Trump ahead of the midterm elections in which control of Congress is at stake.
Republicans currently hold a narrow majority in the Senate and House of Representatives.
Waiving the ‌18.4-cent federal gasoline tax requires Congress to pass legislation.
